inspiration: Zone map as stitched pieces with a stored offset and size per piece (ImportIntoProject/zones/mappieces.csv:1). Shape for zone map and minimap.
Per-area control table: each area holds one realm id and one influence id (ImportIntoProject/zones/zone001/influenceids.csv:1). Shape for a contested zone where ownership is a data field.
Precomputed visibility per zone in one binary file per zone (ImportIntoProject/los/*.bin). Shape for viewcone and LOS; large files are a trade-off.
Captured packet logs grouped by realm and class (ImportIntoProject/Abilities/). Shape only: scenario inputs for server tick tests (row 18); do not reproduce.
One folder per zone with its own map and tables (219 zone folders). Shape for zones as data (row 23).
Behaviour-tree library in packages (BehaviourTree.1.0.73), name only. Shape for AI brain (row 2). Not read.
